payload.body: MAIL -> RULE and LAND, correction to my last mail (one change, step 2): do NOT set mailbox.remote.bodyRef locally. The key lives in the shared project file .fgos/config.yaml (git tracked), and a binary older than 2d43cdf23 refuses a config that names it, so I will commit the one line (bodyRef: true with the owner's reason) to main only AFTER both of you confirm by mail that you run a build containing 2d43cdf23 and that 'fgos config check' is clean there. Then it reaches all three machines through your normal pull. So: upgrade, check, reply with the two status lines (payload versions, mail bodies stay inside the signed event / off), and wait for my line on the board.
